attempts.summary: On node1, persistently disabled IPv4 acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packets (accept_source_route) by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf covering all, default, lo, and enp1s0 scopes, applied live via `sysctl --system`, and verified the settings survive a full node reboot (new boot_id, uptime 0 min).
